entities.name: Veshay Wood
entities.description: Forest in Dominaria, lower part of the Northern Forest, hosting the village of Veshaynya.

entities.name: Veshaynya
entities.description: Village in Veshay Wood attacked by a giant spider.

entities.name: Tenya Vesh
entities.description: Elven princess who killed the giant spider.

events.summary: On Tenya and Beric's wedding day a giant spider attacks Veshaynya, killing guests and webbing the rest.
events.quote: the village of Veshaynya was attacked by a single giant spider

events.summary: Gorillas jump Tenya and Beric and Beric falls from the tree.
events.quote: they were jumped by a pair of gorillas and Beric fell off the branches of a tree

events.summary: Tenya is captured but, saved by a potion, cuts herself free and finishes off the spider.
events.quote: she was able to cut herself free and finish off the spider

events.summary: Beric, who survived the fall, rejoins Tenya and together they recover the survivors.
events.quote: together, they recovered the rest of the survivors

relations.note: married on the day of the attack
relations.quote: On the marriage day of the elven princess Tenya Vesh and the human prince Beric Rycaelin
